elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: "will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: "professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards"

elements.element: Professional and workmanlike standard covering the Services generally (unqualified)
elements.evidence: limited to "the Hosting Services and Support Services" and paired with conformance qualified "in all material respects"
"will perform in all material respects in accordance with its then-current documentation"
"for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery"

elements.element: 90-day services warranty period, measured from performance
elements.evidence: "for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform in all material respects" — conformance diluted by materiality qualifier
"a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software or services"

elements.element: Remedy set limited to repair, replace or refund (no added re-performance)
elements.evidence: "at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund"
"TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance hereunder"
"will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code"
"twelve (12) months following delivery" — fallback threshold exceeded using the preferred-only amount
"ninety (90) days following performance" — preferred-only period, not the fallback bargain
"in all material respects in accordance with its then-current documentation"
"at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund" — adds re-performance beyond the remedy set

reasons: The inserted warranty dilutes the core conformance obligation with "in all material respects" for both the software/documentation warranty and the services warranty; the preferred (and fallback) position requires conformance, not material conformance.
The remedy set adds "re-performance" and vests election in TrueLink ("at TrueLink's option"), expanding beyond the playbook's repair, replace or refund remedies.

Fallback is not independently satisfied: the drafted periods (12 months / 90 days) are the preferred amounts, and the conformance standard is still qualified by materiality, so neither level is complete as its own bargain.

Non-minimal additions: "consistent with industry standards", "and applicable specifications", "then-current" and the materiality qualifiers are unnecessary to complete the preferred level and weaken it.
Intent is preserved as to untouched terms: the Y2K warranties, evidence/repair mechanic and the disclaimer paragraph remain effective, and no undefined term is introduced.
